newsitem.title: PERU: Sexual abuse charge in Peru's congress.
newsitem.headline: Sexual abuse charge in Peru's congress.

text.p: Showgirl-turned-legislator Susy Diaz accused a fellow Peruvian congressman on Wednesday of trying to kiss and fondle her.
The flamboyant peroxide blonde did not name the abusive legislator but warned that she would lodge a formal complaint if he forced himself upon her again.
"It is a congressman who is single. I do not want to give names, but I am issuing a warning so that he respects me," Diaz, 32, told reporters.

She was elected to Congress in 1995 after a raunchy election campaign during which she frequently bared her buttocks to voters, showing a large red "13" painted on them to represent her position on the slate.
Once elected, she scandalised fellow legislators with her scanty clothing and her campaigns on behalf of transvestites and homosexuals. In one publicity stunt she arrived for work on a donkey.
